Design scaffolding A/B, 2026-11-09

Same models, same prompts, versions of the Builder's design guidance: none (the original prompt), recipe (a concrete screen layout, spacing and type scale, filled palette and contrast rules), direction (the recipe plus five ready-made visual styles to choose from), reference (direction plus three rules and two reference first-screen shapes on other subjects). Columns appear only for versions run that day; a row marked with another date is a reference from that day. Two fix passes, the bad host excluded. Captions: model, version, trial, whether the app works, build time, and two mechanical signals (theme tokens filled, desktop classes), which are not design scores.
